title: Predictive safety filter enhanced curriculum learning control for efficient vehicle dynamics controller
abstract: arXiv:2608.09653v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent advances in learning-based control have enabled impressive achievements in solving complex control problems in various domains. However, since learning-based control may not be able to realize safety-guaranties, it is of great importance to enhance safety and robustness while maintaining good performances. Take vehicle motion \& dynamics control as an example, in order to overcome the pain points of traditional methods such as heavy parameter calibration effort and learning-based control to bring better performance and efficiency in stability \& agility over prior work for state-based vehicle control tasks, in this work, our method aims to develop a curriculum learning controller enhanced with physics-based predictive safety filter. The validation is conducted with the Python-CarSim platform, demonstrating better improvements and scalability under various maneuvers.

translated_title: 预测性安全过滤器增强的课程学习控制方法，用于高效的车辆动力学控制器
translated_abstract: 近年来，基于学习的控制方法在解决各领域复杂控制问题方面取得了令人瞩目的成就。然而，由于基于学习的控制可能无法提供安全性保证，因此在保持良好性能的同时提升安全性和鲁棒性至关重要。以车辆运动与动力学控制为例，为了克服传统方法的痛点（如繁重的参数标定工作），并使基于学习的控制方法在状态类车辆控制任务中，相比以往工作在稳定性与敏捷性方面带来更好的性能和效率，本工作旨在开发一种由基于物理的预测性安全过滤器增强的课程学习控制器。验证工作在Python-CarSim平台上进行，结果表明该方法在各种驾驶机动工况下具有更好的改进效果和可扩展性。
tldr: 本文提出一种由基于物理的预测性安全过滤器增强的课程学习控制器，在保证安全性的同时，使车辆动力学控制相比传统方法在稳定性、敏捷性和可扩展性方面表现更优。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a curriculum learning controller enhanced with a physics-based predictive safety filter, achieving improved stability, agility, and scalability in vehicle dynamics control while ensuring safety.
